# Roadtrip Planner

> Free AI-powered road trip generator. Creates smart tourist routes sorted by geographic proximity and opens them directly in Google Maps with one tap.

## What it does

Two planning flows:

- **GPS flow** — User shares their current location. The app generates the best nearby stops for a day trip, sorted from nearest to farthest. Works as a live checklist as you go.
- **Destination flow** — User types a city or country. The app builds a logical multi-day chain route connecting stops in geographic order, with split Google Maps links per day group.

## How it works

1. Real POIs are fetched from OpenTripMap (verified coordinates, filtered by travel style)
2. Groq (Llama 3.3) writes descriptions, highlights, and practical info for each stop
3. Stops are sorted using a nearest-neighbor algorithm (haversine distance)
4. Google Maps links are generated — one tap opens the full route

## Key features

- No account required — entirely free
- Works offline after first load (localStorage persistence)
- Trips survive page refresh and can be shared via URL
- Supports English and Spanish
- Travel styles: culture, nature, food, adventure, beaches, architecture, hidden gems
- Transport modes: car, motorcycle, mixed

## Who it's for

Travelers who want a ready-to-go itinerary in seconds — whether exploring a city today or planning a trip abroad next month.

## Tech

Next.js (Pages Router), Groq API (Llama 3.3-70b), OpenTripMap, Nominatim/OSM, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui. Hosted on Vercel.

## Source

Built as an open side project. No ads, no tracking beyond Vercel Analytics.
